t: Class of the Titans: The Game Pan
d: Cronus poses as Amaltheia, the goat who raised his son Zeus, and whisks Zeus off for a fatal game of battle chess

t: The Triplets: Fearless John
d: The Zombie, the Butcher and the Crazy Clown are three evil characters who have taken over an amusement park many years ago and refuse to budge until someone passes the test of surviving a night in the park.

t: The Triplets: Hansel and Gretel
d: Hansel, Gretel, and the Triplets can't resist entering a village made entirely of candy. It doesn't take them long to realize that this place is a trick, but it's too late.

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Goes to the South Seas
st: Pippi Goes to the South Seas
d: Captain Longstocking docks in the village to pick up Pippi and take her with him to the South Seas.  Annika and Tommy are given permission to go along and they all set sail for adventure on the high seas.

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Meets Some Pearl Poachers
d: When the Hoptoad docks on an exotic island, Pippi, Tommy and Annika are left in charge of the Island pearls.  They have to use their wits and strength to outsmart a pair of Pearl Poachers.

t: Pippi Longstocking: Pippi Goes Home
d: Following their stay on the exotic island it is time to go home.  After rescuing Thunder Karlson and Bloom from a deserted island they set sail for home.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: Realizing local octogenarian Agatha Dimplecorn is a surprisingly-powerful combatant, Skor attempts to channel her rage towards the Posse – especially since the Dinos respect their elders too much to fight back.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: The KFDP learns of a MASSIVE CRYSTAL located somewhere in the middle of the desert. Edgar realizes that it’s actually quite a far distance outside of town. The dinos load up their DUV’s and head for an impromptu road trip.

t: Massive Monster Mayhem
d: Master Mayhem receives a visit from… himself! From the future?! With two MM’s in the mix, Earth is destined for doom... if they could just stop arguing. Meanwhile RoBro flexes his mechanical muscles in a Monster Mashdown that’ll go down in history.

t: Massive Monster Mayhem
d: Master Mayhem’s got a new phone! It’s got apps, lasers, and it even talks. This super smart phone might even out-smart Master Mayhem himself. Meanwhile, Dome Diddy Dome is powered by a teen girl’s phone, dialing up destruction on Planet Earth.

t: Class of the Titans: Like a Rolling Stone
d: Cronus strikes a deal with the crafty Sisyphus' freedom from his eternal punishment, in exchange for the life of one of the heroes

t: Sabrina's Secret Life: What’s In A Name?
d: Sabrina and Cassandra bicker their way through another potion-making assignment at the witches’ academy. Their arguing causes them to spill the entire vial of Salvia Muscaria: an extremely rare herb!

t: Sabrina's Secret Life: Greendale Idol
d: At the witches’ academy, the Sabrina and Cassandra learn about the dangers of using magic carelessly.

t: Sabrina's Secret Life: A Midsummer’s Nightmare
d: Shakespeare’s Puck leads us into this Bard-inspired story. and makes Sabrina the director.

t: Transformers: Armada: Drift
d: Thrust flees into the depths of Cybertron, pursued by Hot Shot and Wheeljack - and, separately, Starscream, who saves the children from being killed. The children discover the origins of the minicons.

t: Transformers: Armada: Portent
d: Thrust joins Sideways by passing through a portal deep underground: his pursuers follow and find themselves on Cybertron's moon, which begins to disintegrate. To everyone's horror, Unicron is revealed.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under The Fishbowl!
st: Twenty Thousand Leagues Under The Fishbowl!
d: An impending ecological disaster involving a sunken oil tanker on the lip of an underwater volcano sends the city into a panic. Nia's uncle Captain Abbott is to lead an submarine mission to raise the tanker before it can explode.

t: Yu-Gi-Oh! VRAINS: Diagnosis:  Deletion
d: Blue Angel’s looking to Speed Duel her way to victory, but the diabolical doctor she’s battling is set on prescribing a dose of defeat!

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: The museum has hit desperate times. After failing to meet its bills, the word comes down that it will be forced to shutter its doors permanently if it doesn’t come up the required cash. The posse tries to brainstorm a quick fix to the situation.

t: Kung Fu Dino Posse
d: Skor decides that if he can’t beat the Kung Fu Dino Posse, he might as well make fools of them – literally. Thanks to an unstable new cloning device, Skor makes clones of all four Dinos – and turns them into clowns.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Game Over
d: When Buddy and Vince skip school one too many times to play their favourite video arcade game "Monster Attack", they find themselves magically transformed into a real life version of the game.

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: Cold Blood Warm Hearts / The Spider and the Files
st: Cold Blood Warm Hearts / The Spider and the Files
d: Kristin drives out to a small fishing community to investigate a local sighting of a sea monster. / Sixteen year old Simon's fascination with spiders becomes a nightmare when his turn of the century town is infested with arachnids of every variety.

t: Sabrina The Animated Series: The Grandparent Trap
d: When Sabrina hears that her Grandparents are coming for visit she is excited. They have a important announcement to make.

t: Sabrina The Animated Series: I Got Glue Babe
d: Everyone is fed up with Sabrina and Gem's constant rivalry. Sabrina casts a spell to make Gem and herself closer. But she uses too much potion and it causes them to stick together.

t: Zapped
d: Zoey is having a hard time with her new step-family and new school, but suddenly a dog training app gives her control of all the boys around her.

t: Class of the Titans: Cronus' Keystroke
d: Cronus gets his hands on Theresa's pendant.  He convinces the magical Telkhines to unlock its secret by giving them their enemy, Poseidon

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Jetstream Adventure!
d: Elwood and Beanie are staying up all night watching a marathon of old "Jetstream" science fiction episodes on television.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: Monstro-Crane of Doom
d: My Goldfish is Evil! Chronicles the hilarious adventures of a boy named Beanie and his tiny pet goldfish Admiral Bubbles. The twist? Admiral Bubbles has evil plans to conquer the world.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: The Army Of Sea Dudes
d: With Mom noticing a certain "tension" between Beanie and his goldfish, she encourages Beanie to act more friendly around him, and that they try working on a project together.

t: My Goldfish is Evil: School Trip To... Aquaworld!
d: Beanie brings Admiral Bubbles on a school trip to Aqua World, hoping his goldfish will learn proper behavior from the other fish. Instead, Admiral Bubbles is outraged at this public display of enslavement.

t: Class of the Titans: Daedalus or Alive
d: Hoping to find some lost papers or inventions left behind by Daedalus, Odie discovers Daedalus is still alive!

t: Class of the Titans: Face Off
d: Neil is no longer the fairest of them all when Adonis appears

t: Class of the Titans: The Deep End
d: The River God, Scamander was defeated by Achilles millennia ago.  Now he wants to even the score by destroying Archie

t: Class of the Titans: Golden Boy
d: Neil's growing arrogance and good fortune draws out the goddess Nemesis, who decides our Golden Boy needs to be taught a lesson

t: Tales from the Cryptkeeper: The Avenging Phantom / Myth Conceptions
d: Ten year old Jimmy is afraid to sleep in the dark. / While digging in Greece, a greedy Fortune Hunter searches out the ancient cave ruins of the Greek legend Medusa.
